definition.closing_call: call whose grasp.evidence.checks is non-empty (latch in CLOSING, checks evaluated)
definition.reach_only: closing call whose only failing check is reach
definition.geometry_frame: grasp.alignment.geometry_frame; frame f is the observation of call seq f (verified: age 0 calls have geometry_frame = seq-1)
definition.cf_hand_rel_mm: |p_k - H_k H_g^-1 c_k|: stale centroid c_k moved rigidly with panda_hand from the obs of geometry frame g to call k; p = panda_leftfinger origin; FK from panda_libero.urdf at robot_state (reproduces logged reach_mm, see fk_reach_abs_err_mm_max)
definition.cf_at_geom_frame_mm: |p_g - c_k|: reach evaluated with the hand pose of the frame where the geometry was observed
definition.cf_true_moved_mm: |p_k - (c_k + (o_k - o_g))|: stale centroid shifted by the sim displacement of the manipulated object body (ground truth, translation only)
definition.carried: object body pose in panda_hand frame drifted <= 20 mm since geometry frame AND object moved >= 20 mm (3D) since geometry frame (sim_state_image)
definition.manipulated_object: free MuJoCo body nearest (3D) to AG3S manipulated centroid at the geometry frame of the first closing call
definition.lifted_objects_sim: free bodies whose z rose >= 20 mm above their z at call 0 obs
definition.hold_nearest_body: INFERRED attribution: free MuJoCo body nearest to the violating sphere point (verdict_reasons[].evidence.row.point_m, planned step) at the call's obs
definition.classification_A: no attach; >=1 reach-only closing call with object occluded, carried by the hand, hand-relative reach <= 120 mm; >=1 gripper<->esdf collision HOLD after the first reach-only refusal whose violating point is nearest to the manipulated object
definition.classification_rule_v1_lift: first rule (lift >= 20 mm instead of carried); gives the same A/not-A split on all 18 failed episodes
